name: Cain Van Norden
strengths: Van Norden's 6-7 length creates natural disruption -- extends, keeps blockers off his frame, and collapses pockets.
Van Norden shows surprising first-step quickness for nearly 300 pounds off the snap.
Van Norden's primary power is a heavy bull rush that walks tackles into the backfield.
Van Norden redirects with basketball footwork and can threaten multiple gaps along the front.
weaknesses: Van Norden is still raw technically -- limited counters beyond the bull rush and inconsistent leverage/hand placement.
comparison: Van Norden comps to Arik Armstead -- long 6-7 class defensive lineman with power and developmental pass-rush upside (size-matched to Van Norden's 6-7 / 299 mold).
projection: Van Norden projects as develop into the DL room with technique focus, earn early pass-rush package snaps, then compete for a starting edge/5-tech role -- starter upside as a length-and-power disruptor if hands catch up to traits.
schemeFit: Van Norden fits White as a long 5-tech/edge who can also reduce inside in odd fronts.
insiderNotes: Vault film desk on Cain Van Norden via On3->Hudl (St. Frances Academy junior clips): 6-7 / 299 DL out of District Heights, MD. Florida 2027 commit. Basketball convert with high ceiling.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from On3 Hudl. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default. Band-appropriate (not generational overclaim).
